messages:
marcus lee: Quick syncwe're scheduling the v1->v2 migration next Tue. Freeze code samples 48hrs before. Need an owner for the deprecation FAQ and rollback steps.
emma cho: I can take the FAQ + public notice. Will keep it short (what changes, timeline, how to opt into compat shim).
noah fry: SDK note: we'll ship a compat shim for 90 days. We'll emit a warning on first use and log telemetry. Docs should show both old and new snippet patterns and a clear 'remove this after X' callout.
marcus lee: Good. Also: embed model dims change (1536 -> 2048). Add an index-migration CLI example and a quick curl to detect dim mismatch (expect 422).
emma cho: Proposed curl example for docs: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":["test"]}'
# returns 422 if dims mismatch
```
noah fry: We'll provide a `--dry-run` option on the migrate tool and sample JSON output to paste into docs. Also adding a small fallback mapping in the SDK for common index names.
cli-bot: docs-ci: PR #4301 opened (migration/faq-and-snippets) by @emma-cho  preview available, lint passed.
emma cho: I'll localize the FAQ for FR/DE after the PR lands. Marcus, can ops keep a pinned v1 route for critical tenants for 14 days post-announcement?
emarcus lee: Ops confirmed: pinned v1 available on request for up to 14 days. Add contact: ops+dedicated@redwood.ai.
noah fry: Final ask: include a rollback section with exact steps: revert client to previous version, restore old snippets, re-run index restore from backup. I'll add CLI commands for each step in the SDK README.
emma cho: Thanks all  I'll merge once localization is queued and @noah confirms example output.
